site.region: Serving Los Angeles, Orange County and beyond

bio.short: DJ Play (Dawaun Lucas) is a wedding and corporate event DJ and MC from Compton, mixing since 2008. Open format music for every generation and a polished MC, across Los Angeles and Orange County.
long: DJ Play is Dawaun Lucas, a DJ and MC from Compton who has been mixing since 2008. He's open format, so a set can move from golden-era hip-hop to the funk that came before it, then through R&B, throwbacks and today's hits. Every generation in the room hears a song they know.

He works the mic as well as the decks. At a wedding that means a processional that lands, a grand entrance with energy, and toasts that run smoothly. At a corporate event it means background music while people mingle, clean handoffs between speeches and dancing, and an MC who represents your brand well.

For more than 15 years he has played weddings, corporate events and galas, private parties, church celebrations and community gatherings across Los Angeles. Send your must-play and do-not-play lists ahead of time, and he keeps it clean whenever the room calls for it.
